note: Tanzania: nationals of the countries and territories listed (with the British, New Zealand and Australian territories' passports) enter without a visa for 90 days; nationals of the countries referred to the Commissioner General of Immigration need a visa beforehand; everyone else gets a visa on arrival or an e-Visa beforehand (taken as on arrival; the stay is set at the port). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Tanzania
sources.said: Visitors to Tanzania must obtain either a visa on arrival or an e-Visa unless they are citizens of one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who must obtain a visa from one of the Tanzanian diplomatic missions . ... Holders of ordinary passports of the following countries and territories may enter Tanzania without a visa for up to 90 days: Angola Antigua and Barbuda Bahamas Barbados Belize Botswana Brunei Burundi Cyprus Dominica Democratic Republic of Congo Eswatini Gambia Ghana Grenada Guyana Hong Kong Jamaica Kenya Kiribati Lesotho Macau Madagascar Malawi Malaysia Malta Mauritius Mozambique Namibia Nauru Papua New Guinea Romania Rwanda Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent Samoa Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Sudan Tonga Trinidad and Tobago Tuvalu Uganda Vanuatu Zambia Zimbabwe In addition, visa exemption applies to holders of passports issued to residents of the following territories ... Citizens of other countries may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Citizens of the following countries and territories must obtain a visa in advance, as they require approval of the Commissioner General of Immigration or the Commissioner of Immigration: Afghanistan Bangladesh Burkina Faso Chad Guinea Guinea Bissau Eritrea Iran Iraq Kyrgyzstan Lebanon Mali Mauritania Niger Pakistan Palestine Sierra Leone Somalia Syria Tajikistan Turkmenistan Uzbekistan Yemen
